## Scope
Explain the problem, motivation and intended behavior.

## Linked issue / decision
Add links to the approved issue, masterplan and architecture decision.

## Impact and verification
- [ ] Planning-only change (required before gate G0)
- [ ] No executable application code, installer or release artifact before G0
- [ ] Licenses and authorizations are compatible with AGPL-3.0-only
- [ ] Security, privacy, backwards compatibility and risks evaluated
- [ ] Documentation updated

## Tests and evidence
Explain how to verify changes. After G0, provide unit/integration/e2e results as appropriate.

## Owner approval
**Only @TheRoyalCaptain can authorize merging into official Domyro.** Review requests, other maintainers' approvals or passing automated checks are not official acceptance.

## Notes
For high-risk security matters use private vulnerability reporting, not a public PR.
